title: You Can Get A Good Knife Under $12. This Is Not It!
text: You Can Get A Good Knife Under $12. This Is Not It!. I decided to try the product and purchased two.  I realized it that the blade is not as in the picture. It appears to have a bend or rocking motion to the cut however blade point is flat. Secondly after initial hand was the minimal color on the handles came off. I would be afraid to even use them on carrots because the blade is extremely thin and handle after second hand wash already seems to have give.
